title: Playable game prototype built with Fable 5
author: Axel Bitblaze 🪓
verification: Fetched from X via twitter-cli from global-search; original author and post URL preserved.
note: Original post did not expose a complete repeatable prompt. Treat this as a real showcase post, not a verified tutorial.
originalText:
Using Claude Fable 5, I built a model that predicts the entire 2026 FIFA world cup.. 

every single game, not just the final..

so let me break the whole thing down. what it does, how it works, and exactly how i built it..

#1 First what it does:

it predicts all 104 games of the tournament. not just who lifts the trophy, but every group match, every knockout, the full path from the round of 32 to the final..

everything lands in one dashboard:
 > group stage, every match with each team's win % and the chance of a draw > standings, how all 12 groups are projected to finish > bracket, the full knockout tree with each team's odds of advancing > champion odds, who's most likely to actually win it all

and it doesn't freeze after one prediction. 

the moment a real game is played, it locks that result in and re-runs everything around it. 

so the odds move live as the tournament goes, week by week you watch favorites rise and contenders collapse.

#2. How it works:

the core idea is simple. the model only ever predicts one thing, a single match. the real trick is the repetition.

it learns from decades of match history, then plays the whole tournament out from the first game to the final, tens of thousands of times. 

each run it records who advanced and who won. do that enough and you stop getting one guess and start getting real odds, one team lifts the trophy in maybe 14% of the runs, another in 9%, and so on.

#3. So, how i built it ?

i didn't hand-write most of the code. i broke the project into 4 pieces, described each one to fable, and let it build while i focused on getting the football logic exactly right.

- The data
 every international match going back over a century, around 50,000 games, plus each team's elo rating, which is the truest measure of strength, and the official 2026 schedule. 

garbage data means garbage predictions, so this part mattered most.

- The features
 i turned that raw history into signals the model can learn from, the elo gap between the two teams, recent form, goals scored and conceded, and a home boost for the hosts, usa, canada and mexico.

- The model
 for each match it predicts the expected goals for both sides, then turns that into win, draw and loss probabilities plus a likely scoreline. that's what feeds the simulation.

- The tournament engine
 this was the hard part. the 2026 world cup is brand new, 48 teams, 12 groups, a round of 32 that's never existed before, and 8 "best third-placed" teams that slot into the bracket by a fixed fifa table. 

even the group tiebreakers changed this year, head to head now counts before goal difference. 

get any of it wrong and the whole bracket falls apart, so i built it carefully and tested the format until it was exact, then wrapped it in a simulation loop that plays the tournament out tens of thousands of times.

and the last piece, the live part. 

as real results come in, they get locked, and only the unplayed games get re-simulated. 

that's what makes it a living model instead of a one-time prediction.

all of it outputs to a clean dashboard you can actually read and screenshot..

right now, before kickoff, it already has a clear favorite to lift the trophy.. 👀

btw who's your pick to win the 2026 world cup?

FABLE 5 ONE-SHOT A CALL OF DUTY ZOMBIES CLONE FROM A SINGLE LAZY PROMPT

No planning mode.

No back-and-forth.

No hours of prompting Claude.

Just one sentence:

"Make me a COD Zombies clone, single-player, and make the shooting feel good."

The distance between "I have an idea" and "I'm playing it" is collapsing fast.

We're entering an era where vibe-coding an entire game is becoming a one-sentence problem.

Fable 5 / Mythos brought the magic back for me holy shit 👽

give this monster a /goal and it will blow your mind

i know i know, just UI stuff, but i was terrified of this mission lol as the dashboard was getting complex and thought this would be a solid thing to point it at

my current workflow is usually to build well researched imp plans w/ a lot of back and forth, i was dreading it for this task... 

said fuck it and just gave it a one prompt goal...

Fable is amazing at surfacing bugs mid-flight: take advantage of this, wire it into the initial prompt or goal w/something like 'continuously sweep for bugs and log them in a file, we'll discuss post mission' or just 'YOLO fix any bug you find'

Give it clear constraints and clarity on what 'done' looks like. I could have done better at this. 

Let Fable COOK, don't try and steer it too hard. Give it a couple skills maybe, that's it. 

Enjoy the Fable BBQ cookout. I am maxing this shit out until the 22nd.

title: 「AI開発に一斉ブレーキを」と世界に訴えた翌週、Anthropicが最強モデル「Claude Fable」を...
author: AI×Businessの研究｜Eiko.Hiyama
verification: Fetched from X via twitter-cli from global-search; original author and post URL preserved.
note: Original post did not expose a complete repeatable prompt. Treat this as a real showcase post, not a verified tutorial.
originalText:
「AI開発に一斉ブレーキを」と世界に訴えた翌週、Anthropicが最強モデル「Claude Fable」を投入。出力100万トークンあたり$50という値付けの中身を、技術系チャンネルFireshipが検証しています。

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

【"Mythosクラス"の最強モデル、ただし期間限定公開】
動画では、Claude Fableは内部開発の「Mythos 5」と同じ土台で、安全のための分類器モデルを被せた版だと説明されています。価格は出力100万トークンあたり$50（Opusの$25の2倍）。有料Claudeプランなら6/22まで使え、その後はトークン課金のみ——「FOMOを煽る巧みな施策」と評されています。

【ガードレールは"蒸留対策"でもある】
サイバーセキュリティ・生物・化学・モデル蒸留に関わる質問は、分類器が検知してClaude Opus 4.8の回答に差し替えられる構造だと紹介。結果として、DeepSeekやKimiといった中国勢が同等のオープンソース版をすぐ作るのは難しい、という見立てが語られています。

【エンジニアの初期評価は上々】
GPU向け言語「Bend」の作者が、Fableが自分のコードを大幅に高速化したことを「自分にとっての特異点の瞬間」と称賛。動画主自身もUI生成を試し、崩れがちなSVG（ベクター画像）をきれいに描く点や、Tinder風スワイプアニメの再現度に驚いたとレポートしています。

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

「ブレーキを」と訴えた直後に最強モデル——この矛盾をどう読むか。煽り口調の動画ながら、価格・制約・実力の要点はしっかり押さえた一本です。
